body:
I've now tried salvia a few times before reporting on my experiences here.  It seemed a bit superficial to report on just the initial trip so I tried it four times in similar dosages worth noting (1/4 gram; 20x).
Having had a lot of experience with LSD long ago I expected something similar to that experience, but it was quite different. Oh there were patterns, but not the well-integrated kinds that blend into the textures of most everything, the salvia patterns stole the show. But thats only if my eyes were closed.
The smoke was almost too hot to handle. I coughed it out every time. And the burn in my lungs dominated the first minute or so before I could relax. With eyes open I was quickly disoriented and uncomfortable the first time in most positions (sitting\lying on the bed) so I decided to just lie back and close my eyes to get comfortable since there was nothing much happening visually.
The immediate vision of a lattice-like shape of something that seemed to be alive grew out from my forehead and was particularly close to my eyes (though closed) while it pulsated slightly and its plant/human texture rotated around slowly. It seemed to be made of a cross between wax and plastic. There also seemed to be an intelligence in it that was happy and possibly laughing. It was a 3-dimensional thing with nothing in the background. At the center of each intersection of the lattice was what looked like an eye.  I came down fairly fast, though happy, but never felt far from reality
I came down fairly fast, though happy, but never felt far from reality
, always knowing where I was and feeling my body in a kind of waxy air.
And that was pretty much all there was to the first trip. During the others the lattice didnt appear, but a waxy plastic 3D wall of familiar objects instead. There was a too-familiar sense of the repeated parts of things like a phone or a cup or a pencil and I got a bit claustrophobic and bored with them. The heat of the smoke was even more intense and I decided not to continue, worrying that it was damaging my lungs.
All-in-all it was mildly interesting at that dosage but I wouldnt go deeper simply because the heat was too much and the images didnt beckon as Id hoped.
